ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; visible ventral surfaces exhibit an approximate 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white fields across the mid and distal lobe areas; left lobe contains a singular, sharp black linear mark extending from the inner proximal margin towards the center; right lobe displays a fragmented, mottled black-to-white transition along its inner proximal border.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Visible irregular micro-serrations along the non-submerged upper trailing edge of the left lobe; right lobe trailing edge topography is heavily altered and obscured by dense calcified clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the distal margins of both lobes, tapering to acute tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-density clusters of circular, high-contrast white and beige pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent, longitudinal black linear disruption on the mid-white field of the left lobe; smaller, faint horizontal scratch marks visible on the distal white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive external barnacle colonization (Coronulidae) on the distal tips, creating significant 3D textural anomalies and altering the pixel boundary of the lobe margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive vertical 'dripping' pattern of black pigmentation into the white field located at the proximal transition zone near the center of the fluke.
